title: Is the HYPE real? Winspace Agile Roadbike & Hyper Wheels Review

takeaways.text: Compared with his steel and titanium bikes, it clearly feels like an aero speed machine.
It is less comfortable than steel or titanium but has enough compliance that he felt fine after a 135 km ride on a bare carbon saddle.
He recommends it as a fast carbon setup without a big-brand price; it was the most fun he had had on carbon in a while.

disclosure: Winspace sent the frame and wheels; he says it is not paid and Winspace did not review the video.
summary: A steel-and-titanium fan's review of the Winspace Agile with Hyper D67 wheels after about 700–800 km.
